answer: Histories are stored in mesa, checked in nebula, and zephyr makes public each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 3 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 3314 identities would post 3988 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
